name: Festival of Play 2026 - Dundee
description: Join Digital Schoolhouse and Electronic Arts for a fun-filled creative careers and computing conference for school students and teachers! The Festival of Play returns, brought to you by Digital Schoolhouse and Electronic Arts. Immerse your students in a day of interactive workshops, industry-led talks, and hands-on gaming as we dive deep into the technology and creativity driving the UK video games industry.
short_description: A creative careers and computing conference for school students and teachers, brought to you by Digital Schoolhouse and EA.
